svg.text: FLOOR PLAN 1:200 - base plates (+), anchors 2 x M12 each, bottom rail
Base plates: 80 pcs 150 x 150 x 10, each 2 x M12 chemical anchors (load per upright: see asrs_design.py report 6).
Tolerance item (design targets - confirm with EN 15620 / FEM 9.831 and the supplier)
Floor flatness under the rack and rail (class for VNA / AS-RS, EN 15620 / DIN 15185)
Bottom rail straightness (lateral) over the full length
Bottom rail height (level) over the full length
Top guide rail lateral position to bottom rail (plumb line)
Installation sequence: 1 slab check + survey grid; 2 rail on grout (alignment laser, shims), anchors;
3 rack frames + beams, plumb and level; 4 top ties + guide rail aligned to the bottom rail (plumb);
5 crane erection, wheel alignment, buffers; 6 survey record of every tolerance item before commissioning.
Design values only - the slab design (thickness, reinforcement, joints away from the rail) is done by the structural engineer.
Combined FMS VC20 + RB - item F3 AS/RS
Rail and floor layout, anchor points, tolerances
rail S355 flat bar 50x30 on grout
DESIGN - to be checked and released by the responsible engineer
